sources.name: ACLED
sources.license_summary: EULA: licence 'to develop, publish, and distribute materials incorporating the Licensed Content for non-commercial purposes' ... materials must be 'transformative, such that they cannot be reverse engineered'; 'The Licensee is not permitted to reproduce, republish, redistribute...'; public-sector bodies need a public-sector licence.
sources.notes: Account required; raw data redistribution not allowed.

sources.name: Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de l'Analyse Démographique et Économique (ANSADE)
sources.license_summary: ANSADE site footer: '© 2026 Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de l'Analyse Démographique et Économique. Tous droits réservés.' No open licence found.
sources.notes: React SPA; content served by a public WordPress JSON API at https://admin.ansade.mr/wp-json/ansade/v1 (e.g. /publications/ returns all 569 publications with direct file URLs; categories: Prix 180, Monographies régionales 105, Conjonctures 82, RGPH 53, Commerce extérieur 46, IPI 39, Comptes nationaux 32, Emploi 15, Annuaires 13, Élevage 12, Pauvreté 8, Santé 7...). Mostly PDF; a few XLSX. Stats portals listed by ANSADE: mauritania.opendataforafrica.org, portail.ansade.mr, ArcGIS RGPH-5 viewer (https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/2ded1160faac4295861634a47ff18d03/page), documentation.ansade.info, anadrim.ansade.mr.

sources.name: ANADRIM – ANSADE NADA microdata catalogue
sources.license_summary: Politique d'accès: 'Toute utilisation des données produites ou gérées par l'ANSADE doit faire l'objet d'une demande d'autorisation adressée à la direction générale de l'ANSADE.' ... 'Les micro-données sont accessibles uniquement aux services et organismes relevant du Système National de la Statistique...' ... 'Les données ne doivent être ni copiées, ni transmises à d'autres personnes ou organisations, directement ou indirectement, sans l'accord écrit préalable de l'ANSADE.'
sources.notes: NADA API works: http://anadrim.ansade.mr/index.php/api/catalog/search?ps=200 lists 22 studies (RGPH 1977/1988/2000/2013/2023, EPCV 1990-2019, EDSM 2001 & 2019-21, MICS 2007/2011/2015, ENESI 2012/2017, RGE 2024, SDI education 2022/2024). Access type 'licensed' (or data_na). Metadata only for us.

sources.name: Portail des statistiques officielles (ANSADE)
sources.license_summary: ANSADE site footer: '© 2026 Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de l'Analyse Démographique et Économique. Tous droits réservés.' No open licence found.
sources.notes: React app backed by https://api.portail.ansade.mr. Public endpoints: /api/themes/, /api/categories/, /api/tableaux/ (137 published tables across 20 themes, with source agency per table) and /api/tableaux/{id}/structure/ (table values as JSON). File export endpoints (/api/export/...) return 401 (auth required) - not attempted further.

sources.name: Autorité de Régulation (ARE)
sources.notes: Joomla site. Telecom 'Observatoire' only offers 3 dashboards dated 31 Dec 2013 (/pdfs/telec_obser_*.pdf). Water/electricity/post observatory pages are empty. Annual activity reports 2000-2024 available as PDFs. No terms of use found.

sources.name: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie (BCM)
sources.license_summary: Mentions légales: 'Le droit d'auteur sur le présent site-web et tous les documents qui y sont contenus appartient à la Banque Centrale de Mauritanie. Ce site Web ne peut être reproduit, en totalité ou en partie, sans le consentement préalable exprès écrit de la Banque Centrale de Mauritanie.'
sources.notes: React SPA; Drupal JSON:API backend at https://bo.bcm.mr (legal text read via https://bo.bcm.mr/fr/jsonapi/node/page?filter[drupal_internal__nid]=1174). Pages 'Statistiques monétaires' (nid 881) and 'Bulletin statistique trimestrielle' (nid 883) currently say 'Contenu en cours de finalisation'. Exchange-rate XLSX files and a rates JSON endpoint are available.

sources.name: Commission Électorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI)
sources.notes: Canva-built site (Arabic + /fr). No downloadable results tables found on-site; reports are linked as Google Drive files; candidate/results app at https://myceni.com (Angular app, data not inspected). No terms of use found.

sources.name: Comité National ITIE Mauritanie
sources.license_summary: CNITIE open data policy (2017): defines open data as data whose 'caractéristiques techniques et juridiques permettent la libre utilisation, réutilisation et redistribution par quiconque' - but names no specific licence.
sources.notes: Local EITI site listed by EITI API; http returned 503, https failed. itie-mauritanie.mr does not resolve. Policy PDF fetched from eiti.org: https://eiti.org/sites/default/files/attachments/2017.07_-_politique_du_cnitie_mauritanien_en_matiere_de_donnees_ouvertes1.pdf

sources.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
sources.license_summary: Sentinel data: Legal Notice (https://sentinels.copernicus.eu/documents/247904/690755/Sentinel_Data_Legal_Notice): 'users shall have a free, full and open access to Copernicus Sentinel Data' incl. '(a) reproduction; (b) distribution; (c) communication to the public; (d) adaptation, modification...'. Other portal content: non-commercial only, no redistribution.
sources.notes: Registration needed for downloads; attribution 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [year]'.

sources.name: National open-data portal (data.gov.mr)
sources.notes: data.gov.mr and opendata.gov.mr do not resolve. The Ministry of Digital Transformation's data strategy (https://mtnima.gov.mr/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Strategie-de-donnees.pdf, seen in search) lists 'Priorité 2.2 - Conception et implémentation du portail des données ouvertes de la Mauritanie' - i.e. planned, not live as far as we could tell.

sources.name: DataverseNL
sources.license_summary: Per-dataset licence.
sources.notes: Harvested into Harvard Dataverse search.

sources.name: Direction Générale du Budget (DGB)
sources.notes: Document library of finance laws (LFI 2014-2026, LFR, PLF), decrees, circulars, budget annexes; files served via /kc/documents/files/<id>/<id>/ links.

sources.name: The DHS Program
sources.license_summary: 'The DHS Program is authorized to distribute datasets for legitimate academic research.' Users 'Agree that the datasets will not be shared with other researchers without the written consent of The DHS Program.'
sources.notes: Registration + project approval required for microdata. STATcompiler/DHS API indicators are separate (not checked here).

sources.name: Dryad
sources.license_summary: CC0 1.0 for all Dryad datasets

sources.name: EITI International Secretariat
sources.license_summary: Content Use Policy (site footer): 'Unless otherwise noted, you may republish our content for free. Please give credit to our source (for web, with direct link, for print with EITI International Secretariat, eiti.org).' EITI Open Data Policy recommends countries 'Release data under an open license, preferably Creative Commons Attribution 4.0'.
sources.notes: Summary data via API https://eiti.org/api/v2.0/summary_data (paginated, JSON) and per-country https://eiti.org/api/v2.0/implementing_country/MR (Mauritania summary data 2005-2022; each record has a 'report_file' XLSX link). Mauritania's 2019 decree on systematic disclosure (https://api.eiti.org/sites/default/files/attachments/en_decree-systematic-disclosure-mauritania_final.pdf) requires bodies to 'Publish their data using a free, open licence.'

sources.name: Ministère du Développement Animal (Élevage)
sources.license_summary: Footer: 'Copyright 2021 - All Right Reserved'
sources.notes: Has a page of livestock-statistics guides/manuals; main livestock census (RGE 2024) is published by ANSADE.

sources.name: FAO FishStat (Fisheries and Aquaculture statistics)
sources.license_summary: CC BY 4.0 (FAO statistical database terms of use)

sources.name: Ministère de l'Hydraulique et de l'Assainissement
sources.notes: Unreachable (HTTPS reset). snde.mr also unreachable (http 404 / https fail).

sources.name: ILOSTAT (International Labour Organization)
sources.license_summary: CC BY 4.0 for databases/datasets published from 3 May 2023

sources.name: IMF data (WEO, DataMapper)
sources.license_summary: Special Terms for Statistical Data: 'Users may download, extract, copy, create derivative works, publish, distribute, and use Data' ... 'Distributed or reproduced Data must appear accurately with attribution to the IMF as the source'. 'For any potential commercial reuse of IMF Data, email copyright@imf.org to request permission.'
sources.notes: Read via WebFetch (curl got 403). Also: 'The IMF prohibits bulk download of information by automated technology without explicit permission' and forbids use for LLM training. Not a CC licence.

sources.name: Institut Mauritanien de Recherches Océanographiques et des Pêches (IMROP)
sources.notes: WordPress site; publications under /document/ and /type_document/rapports/. No terms of use or licence statement found on the site.

sources.name: IRENA (IRENASTAT)
sources.license_summary: Per search results: IRENASTAT page shows '© 2011-2025 IRENA ... All Rights Reserved'; T&Cs: 'No other use shall be made of IRENA's Content without IRENA's advanced written permission.'
sources.notes: irena.org returned 403; terms from search snippets (one snippet from mirror prod-cd.irena.org).

sources.name: ITU DataHub
sources.license_summary: Per search result of the DataHub 'Disclaimer and Terms of Use': you may copy, redistribute and adapt the data for non-commercial purposes if properly cited ('International Telecommunication Union, ITU DataHub').
sources.notes: datahub.itu.int returned 403 to curl/WebFetch. Non-commercial only; third-party indicators follow owners' terms. World Bank catalogue lists it as CC BY 4.0 (inconsistent).

sources.name: Ministère de l'Agriculture et de la Souveraineté Alimentaire
sources.notes: Unreachable (HTTPS reset). Agricultural tables (source MASA/DPCSE) are on portail.ansade.mr.

sources.name: Ministère des Affaires Économiques (economie.gov.mr)
sources.notes: Unreachable: HTTPS connections reset ('unexpected eof') from our network and via WebFetch ('socket hang up').

sources.name: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale
sources.notes: Unreachable (HTTPS reset; WebFetch 'socket hang up'). ANSADE publishes 'Séries de données d'Éducation 1995-2024' and the portal has 6 education tables.

sources.name: Ministère de l'Énergie et du Pétrole (petrole.gov.mr)
sources.notes: Presents a self-signed TLS certificate; not fetched (did not disable verification). eiti.org links to legal texts hosted there (e.g. https://www.petrole.gov.mr/IMG/pdf/code-hcs_modifs_loi-2015-016_1_.pdf).

sources.name: Ministère des Finances (Mauritanie)
sources.license_summary: Footer: 'Copyright ©' / 'حقوق محفوظة' (all rights reserved). No open licence found.
sources.notes: Drupal site; pages /fr/tofe (monthly TOFE PDFs), /fr/Lois (LFI/LFR/PLF), /fr/Rapports (ROFE, debt bulletin, economic report), /fr/budget-citoyen. Footer links to a 'Boost Mauritanie' site (http://boost.budget.ms) - not fetched.

sources.name: Ministère des Pêches et de l'Économie Maritime
sources.license_summary: Footer: 'Copyright 2015 MPIMP - جميع الحقوق محفوظة' (all rights reserved).
sources.notes: SPIP site (Arabic). 'Statistiques' section only has old PDFs (licence lists 2015-2016, factory list 2019).

sources.name: Ministère de la Santé / DHIS2
sources.notes: sante.gov.mr unreachable. DHIS2 instance at https://dhis2.sante.gov.mr redirects to a login page (not bypassed). GHDx lists Health Statistical Yearbooks 2004-2016 (metadata only).

sources.notes: Earthdata Login needed for many downloads; non-NASA data follow sponsor licences.

sources.name: Port Autonome de Nouakchott (Port de l'Amitié)

sources.name: Société Nationale Industrielle et Minière (SNIM)

sources.name: Société Mauritanienne d'Électricité (SOMELEC)

sources.name: Ministère des Transports
sources.notes: Unreachable (HTTPS reset).

sources.name: UN Comtrade
sources.license_summary: Per search results (licence page is JS-rendered): copying, automated downloading, redistribution, publication or commercial use is restricted; re-dissemination of untransformed data requires a premium subscription; 'substantially transformed' data may be shared.
sources.notes: License page fetched but content not rendered without JS; terms summarised from search snippets.

sources.name: UN SDG Global Database (UNSD)
sources.license_summary: No database-specific licence found. UN.org terms: permission to download/copy 'for the User's personal, non-commercial use, without any right to resell or redistribute them or to compile or create derivative works'. UNdata (data.un.org) terms by contrast: 'may be copied freely, duplicated and further distributed provided that UNdata is cited'.
sources.notes: unstats.un.org/sdgs/dataportal is a JS app; no terms text retrievable. UNdata terms verified at https://data.un.org/Host.aspx?Content=UNdataUse. Individual SDG series come from custodian agencies with their own terms.

sources.name: UN World Population Prospects (UN DESA Population Division)
sources.license_summary: CC BY 3.0 IGO

sources.name: UNdata
sources.license_summary: 'All data and metadata provided on UNdata's website are available free of charge and may be copied freely, duplicated and further distributed provided that UNdata is cited as the reference.'
sources.notes: Included for comparison with SDG database terms.

sources.name: UNICEF Data Warehouse (data.unicef.org)
sources.license_summary: Per UNICEF Data for Action posts (search results, page not fetchable): indicators 'are now explicitly licensed under' Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO (CC BY 3.0 IGO).
sources.notes: data.unicef.org returns 403 to curl and WebFetch; licence taken from search-result snippets of https://data.unicef.org/data-for-action/unicef-indicators-on-the-state-of-children-and-women-now-100-percent-open-data-compliant/ - verify manually.

sources.name: UNICEF MICS microdata
sources.notes: mics.unicef.org returns 403 to curl/WebFetch. Per IPUMS (search results) users must register on the UNICEF MICS website (free) and authorization is controlled by UNICEF. Exact redistribution wording not verified.

sources.name: World Bank Microdata Library
sources.license_summary: Open Access category: 'You are free to copy, distribute, adapt, display or include the data in other products for commercial and noncommercial purposes at no cost'. Other categories (direct, public use, licensed, external, data enclave) have narrower conditions.
sources.notes: Access type varies per study. Catalog API: https://microdata.worldbank.org/index.php/api/catalog/search?country[]=MRT&ps=200 (82 entries). No Mauritania EPCV study is in the WB Microdata Library (searches 'EPCV', 'Mauritanie', 'Conditions de Vie Mauritanie' return none); EPCV microdata are only in ANSADE's ANADRIM catalogue (licensed).

sources.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
sources.license_summary: data.who.int: 'Unless specifically indicated otherwise, these Datasets are provided to you under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0), with the additional terms below.' Older WHO page (https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions) grants use 'for public health purposes' and forbids alteration/commercial promotion.
sources.notes: Two WHO terms pages coexist; the newer data.who.int CC BY 4.0 terms appear to govern WHO datasets. Some secondary catalogues still cite CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO for GHO. Attribution: WHO + data-providing country.

sources.name: World Bank Data360
sources.license_summary: CC BY 4.0 for most World Bank series; licence stated per series in Data360 metadata

sources.name: WorldPop (University of Southampton)
sources.license_summary: CC BY 4.0 (WorldPop 2000–2020 releases)
